$comment: The case list every SDK's conformance suite must exercise.
The assertion CODE cannot be shared across seven languages, but the case
LIST is data, and its absence is what let coverage drift: the four later
ports gained six hardening cases the first three never got, so MAX_DEPTH
and MAX_BIGINT_DIGITS - both justified as defences against a hostile peer -
went unasserted in Python and Go for several commits with every gate green.
Each suite asserts it ran every name below. Adding a case here turns every
language red until it is covered, which is the point.
